Request: validate dual-key helper syntax, strict offline signer, and encrypted package handoff with encrypted RSA recipient key
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: 4d3d2abf459f8eccb0daefda9c1731f27bf10640
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, offline signer success/rejection tests, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP encrypted artifact round trip using an encrypted RSA-3072 recipient key, tamper rejection, and updater transaction tests.
Security: test keys and test passphrase are ephemeral runner-only values and are deleted. No production keys or secrets are used. No plaintext package, source archive, production key, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded. Optional ciphertext upload stays disabled until the owner's public encryption key is configured.
